blocks.zh: 第二章：法規要求與監管框架
blocks.en: Chapter 2: Regulatory Requirements and Framework

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Chapter Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 了解全球主要法規機構（FDA、EMA、PIC/S、WHO、CFDA）對生物製藥製造的監管要求，並能比較不同框架的異同
blocks.en: Understand the requirements that the major global regulators (FDA, EMA, PIC/S, WHO, CFDA) place on biopharmaceutical manufacturing, and be able to compare how the frameworks are alike and different

blocks.zh: 掌握「生物安全圍堵（Containment）」與「潔淨室環境分級（Classification）」的根本差異，避免混淆這兩個常被誤解的概念
blocks.en: Grasp the fundamental difference between biosafety "containment" and cleanroom environmental "classification", so that these two commonly misunderstood concepts are not confused

blocks.zh: 理解「封閉製程（Closed Processing）」如何改變廠房設計的思維——從以設施保護產品，轉向以封閉技術保護產品
blocks.en: Understand how "closed processing" changes the way facilities are designed: from protecting the product with the facility to protecting the product with closed technology

blocks.zh: 能夠根據 CPP/CQA 分析，判斷哪些製程步驟需要潔淨室環境分級，哪些不需要
blocks.en: Be able to use CPP/CQA analysis to decide which process steps need a classified cleanroom environment and which do not

blocks.zh: 認識生物製藥生產優化的現代趨勢，包括 ballroom 概念、多產品同室生產，以及法規機構對此類設計的接受度
blocks.en: Become familiar with modern trends in optimizing biopharmaceutical production, including the ballroom concept, multi-product operation in a shared room, and how receptive regulators are to such designs

blocks.zh: 本章內容索引
blocks.en: Chapter Contents

blocks.zh: 2.1 Introduction — 法規概覽導論
blocks.en: 2.1 Introduction: Regulatory Overview

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: cGMP (current Good Manufacturing Practice，現行優良製造規範) 是藥品製造法規的基礎框架。「current」一字代表法規必須跟上最新的科技與產業實踐。
blocks.en: cGMP (current Good Manufacturing Practice) is the foundation of pharmaceutical manufacturing regulation. The word "current" means that the regulations must keep pace with the latest technology and industry practice.

blocks.zh: 本章的核心訊息：全球法規正在趨向一致（harmonized），並且已開始接受生物製藥製造的新趨勢——包括封閉製程、多產品同室生產、與一次性使用系統。
blocks.en: The key message of this chapter: global regulations are converging (harmonized) and have begun to accept new trends in biopharmaceutical manufacturing, including closed processing, multi-product operation in a shared room, and single-use systems.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像全球各國的交通法規——各國都有「駕駛需繫安全帶」的要求，但具體規定略有不同。生物製藥的 cGMP 也是如此：FDA（美國）、EMA（歐盟）、PIC/S（國際）的核心原則相同，細節略有差異。本章的目標就是讓你看懂這張「全球交通法規對照表」。
blocks.en: Think of traffic laws around the world. Every country requires drivers to wear a seat belt, but the specific rules differ slightly. The same is true of cGMP for biopharmaceuticals: FDA (US), EMA (EU) and PIC/S (international) share the same core principles and differ slightly in the details. The aim of this chapter is to help you read this "global traffic-law comparison table".

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 法規在「文字上」可能沒有改變（例如美國 21 CFR Part 211 自 1976 年以來文字未變），但詮釋方式與實際應用卻持續演進。這意味著即使規章沒有更新，監管機構的期望仍會隨時代改變。
blocks.en: The wording of a regulation may not change (for example, the text of US 21 CFR Part 211 has been unchanged since 1976), but how it is interpreted and applied keeps evolving. This means that even when the regulation is not updated, regulators' expectations still change over time.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼法規趨向「harmonized cGMP」對 CDMO 特別重要？對同時服務美國、歐盟、日本客戶的廠商而言，有什麼商業意義？
blocks.en: Why is the trend toward "harmonized cGMP" especially important for a CDMO? What is the commercial significance for a company that serves customers in the US, the EU and Japan at the same time?

blocks.zh: 「封閉製程」的興起如何改變了傳統製藥廠房的設計思維？
blocks.en: How has the rise of "closed processing" changed the design thinking behind traditional pharmaceutical facilities?

blocks.zh: 2.2 Regulatory Requirements and Guidance — 主要法規要求與指引
blocks.en: 2.2 Regulatory Requirements and Guidance: Major Requirements and Guidelines

blocks.zh: 全球法規的共同主題：封閉製程
blocks.en: A common theme across global regulations: closed processing

blocks.zh: 閱讀本節，你會發現一個驚人的規律：無論是美國 FDA、歐盟 PIC/S、中國 CFDA，還是日本 GMP，所有法規都在說同一件事——如果你使用封閉製程，可以放寬廠房環境分級的要求。
blocks.en: As you read this section you will notice a striking pattern: whether it is US FDA, European PIC/S, Chinese CFDA or Japanese GMP, all of the regulations say the same thing: if you use closed processing, the facility environmental classification requirements can be relaxed.

blocks.zh: 封閉製程 (Closed Processing)：產品在整個製造過程中不暴露於周圍環境，透過管路、密封容器、一次性袋子等方式進行
blocks.en: Closed Processing: the product is not exposed to the surrounding environment at any point during manufacture; it is handled through piping, sealed vessels, single-use bags and similar means

blocks.zh: 開放製程 (Open Processing)：產品在某些步驟中暴露於周圍空氣，需要潔淨室環境保護
blocks.en: Open Processing: the product is exposed to the surrounding air during some steps and needs the protection of a cleanroom environment

blocks.zh: 法規框架對照表 Regulatory Framework Comparison
blocks.en: Regulatory Framework Comparison

blocks.zh:
法規文件               重點條款       封閉製程的鬆綁
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PIC/S Part 1 (2013)   5.19(f)       同室多產品同時生產（閉合）可接受
PIC/S Annex 2 (2013)  Item 11       閉合生物反應器可同室操作
                      Item 12       收穫後步驟可同室（有適當防護）
FDA Phase 1 (2008)    Sec.IV        封閉設備可減少環境分級需求
CFDA GMP (2011)       Art.197       使用封閉系統降低交叉汙染
                      Art.30        開放製程需隔離；封閉不需要
                      Art.47        開放操作需受控環境；封閉不需要
Japan GMP (2005)      5.15          盡可能使用封閉設備
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
核心邏輯：封閉 → 環境非 CPP → 可降低分級要求
blocks.en:
Document               Key clause     Relaxation for closed processing
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PIC/S Part 1 (2013)   5.19(f)       Simultaneous multi-product production in one room (closed) is acceptable
PIC/S Annex 2 (2013)  Item 11       Closed bioreactors may be operated in a shared room
                      Item 12       Post-harvest steps may share a room (with adequate protection)
FDA Phase 1 (2008)    Sec.IV        Closed equipment can reduce the need for environmental classification
CFDA GMP (2011)       Art.197       Use closed systems to reduce cross-contamination
                      Art.30        Open processing requires isolation; closed does not
                      Art.47        Open operations require a controlled environment; closed do not
Japan GMP (2005)      5.15          Use closed equipment wherever possible
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Core logic: closed → environment is not a CPP → classification requirements can be lowered

blocks.zh: 想像你在廚房準備食物。如果你在開放的砧板上切菜，廚房必須保持乾淨、無蟲蠅、有適當通風（需要「環境管控」）。但如果你用的是密封的食物調理機，外面的環境就不那麼重要了——食物被保護在機器裡面。
blocks.en: Imagine preparing food in your kitchen. If you are chopping vegetables on an open cutting board, the kitchen must be clean, free of flies and properly ventilated (you need "environmental control"). But if you use a sealed food processor, the surroundings matter much less, because the food is protected inside the machine.

blocks.zh: 生物製藥也是如此：封閉製程 = 密封調理機，開放製程 = 砧板上切菜。封閉時，廠房環境對產品品質的影響降到最低。
blocks.en: The same applies to biopharmaceuticals: closed processing = the sealed food processor, open processing = chopping on the cutting board. When the process is closed, the effect of the facility environment on product quality is minimal.

blocks.zh: Phase 1 豁免 21 CFR Part 211 是一個重要的監管彈性。臨床一期藥物不需完全符合商業生產的 GMP 要求，這讓小型研究機構、學術中心也能進行早期臨床試驗，大幅降低藥物開發的門檻。
blocks.en: The Phase 1 exemption from 21 CFR Part 211 is an important regulatory flexibility. Phase 1 clinical drugs do not need to fully meet the GMP requirements for commercial production, which allows small research organizations and academic centers to conduct early clinical trials and greatly lowers the barrier to drug development.

blocks.zh: 但要注意：臨床二期以後，完整 cGMP 要求就必須嚴格執行。
blocks.en: Note, however, that from Phase 2 onward, full cGMP requirements must be strictly applied.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 接受客戶委託時，必須確認產品的目標市場。若客戶產品同時要在美國、歐盟、中國上市，廠房設計就必須同時符合 FDA、EMA/PIC/S、CFDA 三個法規的要求。
blocks.en: When a CDMO accepts a customer project, it must confirm the product's target markets. If the customer's product is to be marketed in the US, the EU and China at the same time, the facility design must meet the requirements of FDA, EMA/PIC/S and CFDA simultaneously.

blocks.zh: 好消息是：這三個法規體系對封閉製程的鬆綁方向一致，設計一個符合所有要求的設施並不像想像中困難——只要充分理解各法規的具體條款。
blocks.en: The good news is that these three regulatory systems relax requirements for closed processing in the same direction, so designing a facility that satisfies all of them is not as hard as it sounds, provided you understand the specific clauses of each.

blocks.zh: 2.2.2 Global Regulatory Information — 全球法規資訊
blocks.en: 2.2.2 Global Regulatory Information

blocks.zh: 三層法規架構是理解全球監管的關鍵框架：
blocks.en: The three-tier regulatory structure is the key framework for understanding global oversight:

blocks.zh: 國際協調層 (ICH, PIC/S, WHO)：制定跨國技術標準與指引，如 ICH Q7（原料藥 GMP）、ICH Q5 系列（生物製劑品質）
blocks.en: International harmonization tier (ICH, PIC/S, WHO): sets cross-border technical standards and guidelines, such as ICH Q7 (GMP for APIs) and the ICH Q5 series (quality of biotechnological products)

blocks.zh: 地區監管層 (FDA, EMA, CFDA)：各地區具法律效力的法規，產品上市必須遵守
blocks.en: Regional regulatory tier (FDA, EMA, CFDA): legally binding regulations in each region, which must be followed for a product to be marketed

blocks.zh: 生物安全層 (CDC/NIH, IFBA)：針對傳染性生物體的安全操作規範（注意：這與 GMP 是不同的體系！）
blocks.en: Biosafety tier (CDC/NIH, IFBA): safe-handling rules for infectious organisms (note: this is a different system from GMP!)

blocks.zh: 特別注意清單中的 CDC/NIH 和 IFBA——這兩個機構不是藥品品質的監管機構，而是生物安全的監管機構。它們出現在這張清單上，正是為了引出下一節 2.3「圍堵 vs 分級」的重要區分。
blocks.en: Pay particular attention to CDC/NIH and IFBA in the list. These bodies do not regulate drug quality; they regulate biosafety. They appear on this list precisely to lead into the important distinction in the next section, 2.3, "Containment versus Classification".

blocks.zh: 對台灣的 CDMO 而言，還需特別關注 TFDA（台灣食品藥物管理署）的要求，及 ICH 指引在台灣的採納狀態。
blocks.en: For a CDMO in Taiwan, you also need to pay special attention to the requirements of the TFDA (Taiwan Food and Drug Administration) and to the status of ICH guideline adoption in Taiwan.

blocks.zh: 2.2.3 Interpretations and Applications — 法規詮釋的演進
blocks.en: 2.2.3 Interpretations and Applications: The Evolution of Regulatory Interpretation

blocks.zh: Open Processing Era (歷史脈絡):
blocks.en: Open Processing Era (historical context):

blocks.zh: Closed Processing Era (現代趨勢):
blocks.en: Closed Processing Era (modern trend):

blocks.zh: 法規詮釋 (Regulatory Interpretation) 是生物製藥廠房設計中最容易被忽視、但最重要的概念之一。
blocks.en: Regulatory interpretation is one of the most easily overlooked, yet most important, concepts in biopharmaceutical facility design.

blocks.zh: 關鍵洞察：法規文字 ≠ 監管期望。21 CFR Part 211 的文字自 1976 年從未改變，但 FDA 對這些文字的詮釋卻隨著技術進步不斷演化。這意味著：
blocks.en: Key insight: regulatory text ≠ regulatory expectation. The text of 21 CFR Part 211 has never changed since 1976, but FDA's interpretation of that text has kept evolving with technology. This means that:

blocks.zh: 過去需要的設施要求，今日可能已不再必要
blocks.en: Facility requirements that were needed in the past may no longer be necessary today

blocks.zh: 設計師必須了解「當下」的監管期望，而不僅僅是閱讀法規文字
blocks.en: Designers must understand current regulatory expectations, not just read the text of the regulations

blocks.zh: 想像 1976 年只有傳統手術的年代，醫院手術室需要極其嚴格的空氣淨化系統，因為傷口長時間暴露在空氣中。但今天，腹腔鏡手術只需要幾個小孔，傷口暴露時間極短。相同的「保護病人」原則沒有改變，但具體的設施要求已大不相同。
blocks.en: Picture the era of 1976, when only conventional surgery existed. Hospital operating rooms needed extremely strict air purification because the wound was exposed to the air for a long time. Today, laparoscopic surgery needs only a few small incisions and the wound is exposed very briefly. The principle of "protecting the patient" has not changed, but the specific facility requirements are very different.

blocks.zh: 封閉製程對廠房設計的影響，就如同腹腔鏡手術對手術室設計的影響：保護目標不變，但達成方式徹底革新。
blocks.en: The impact of closed processing on facility design is like the impact of laparoscopic surgery on operating room design: the protection goal is unchanged, but the way of achieving it has been completely transformed.

blocks.zh: 「discretionary（非強制性的）」是本節最重要的關鍵字。 任何廠房設計要求，如果超出「保護產品」這個核心目的，都可以被視為非強制性的（雖然有時仍值得實施）。
blocks.en: "Discretionary" is the most important keyword in this section. Any facility design requirement that goes beyond the core purpose of "protecting the product" can be regarded as discretionary (although it is sometimes still worth implementing).

blocks.zh: 這給了工程師和廠商設計自由度，但也帶來責任：你必須能夠科學地論證你的設計選擇是如何保護產品的。
blocks.en: This gives engineers and companies design freedom, but it also brings responsibility: you must be able to justify scientifically how your design choices protect the product.

blocks.zh: 如果一個新建廠房的所有製程步驟都採用封閉製程，傳統的「巢狀潔淨室（nested cleanrooms）」設計還有必要嗎？請用本節的邏輯論述你的答案。
blocks.en: If every process step in a new facility uses closed processing, is the traditional "nested cleanrooms" design still necessary? Use the logic of this section to argue your answer.

blocks.zh: 什麼情況下，廠商可能選擇主動增加「非強制性（discretionary）」的設施要求？有哪些商業或品質上的理由？
blocks.en: Under what circumstances might a company choose to add "discretionary" facility requirements voluntarily? What commercial or quality reasons could there be?

blocks.zh: 2.3 Containment versus Classification — 生物安全圍堵 vs 環境分級（最重要觀念）
blocks.en: 2.3 Containment versus Classification: Biosafety Containment vs Environmental Classification (the Most Important Concept)

blocks.zh: Containment (圍堵) is typically reserved for:
blocks.en: Containment is typically reserved for:

blocks.zh: Classification (分級) refers to a room environment cleanliness level as related to product exposure. An assumption that higher BSL containment relates to higher room environment classification would be incorrect. BSL containment is related to the hazard of the organism. Classification is related to the degree of the organism's exposure to the room environment.
blocks.en: Classification refers to a room environment cleanliness level as related to product exposure. An assumption that higher BSL containment relates to higher room environment classification would be incorrect. BSL containment is related to the hazard of the organism. Classification is related to the degree of the organism's exposure to the room environment.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 本章最重要觀念！ Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes: The Most Important Concept in This Chapter!

blocks.zh: 這是整個生物製藥廠房設計中最容易混淆、也最重要的概念之一。
blocks.en: This is one of the most easily confused, and most important, concepts in all of biopharmaceutical facility design.

blocks.zh: 請牢記這個根本差異：
blocks.en: Remember this fundamental difference:

blocks.zh: 生物安全圍堵 (Containment) = 保護工作人員和環境，防止危險生物體「逃出去」
blocks.en: Biosafety containment = protects personnel and the environment by keeping hazardous organisms from "getting out"

blocks.zh: 環境分級 (Classification) = 保護產品，防止環境汙染物「進入」產品
blocks.en: Environmental classification = protects the product by keeping environmental contaminants from "getting in"

blocks.zh: 這兩個方向完全相反！
blocks.en: The two directions are exactly opposite!

blocks.zh: 雙向防護的比喻：
blocks.en: An analogy for two-way protection:

blocks.zh: 想像一位病毒學家在實驗室研究高致病性流感病毒，同時需要生產一種病毒疫苗：
blocks.en: Imagine a virologist who studies a highly pathogenic influenza virus in the laboratory and also has to produce a virus vaccine:

blocks.zh: 生物安全圍堵 = 負壓房間、HEPA 排氣、防護服 → 防止病毒「逃出」實驗室，保護外面的人
blocks.en: Biosafety containment = negative-pressure rooms, HEPA exhaust, protective clothing → keeps the virus from "escaping" the laboratory and protects people outside

blocks.zh: 環境分級 = 正壓潔淨室、HEPA 送風、潔淨服 → 防止環境塵埃「進入」產品，保護疫苗品質
blocks.en: Environmental classification = positive-pressure cleanrooms, HEPA supply air, cleanroom garments → keeps environmental dust from "entering" the product and protects vaccine quality

blocks.zh: 如果是高致病病毒疫苗廠，這兩個要求必須同時滿足，且常常在技術上相互衝突（負壓 vs 正壓）。廠房工程師必須設計出能同時解決兩者的方案。
blocks.en: For a facility making a highly pathogenic virus vaccine, both requirements must be met at the same time, and they often conflict technically (negative vs positive pressure). Facility engineers must design a solution that resolves both.

blocks.zh: 以中文來說：既要防止病毒從實驗室逃出（生物安全），又要防止環境汙染產品（GMP）——這就是生物製藥廠設計最大的挑戰之一。
blocks.en: In plain terms: you must prevent the virus from escaping the laboratory (biosafety) and also prevent the environment from contaminating the product (GMP). This is one of the biggest challenges in biopharmaceutical facility design.

blocks.zh: 為什麼歷史上會產生混淆？
blocks.en: Why did this confusion arise historically?

blocks.zh: 早期生物科技產業剛起步時，對 GMO 的環境風險有過度擔憂，許多廠商便把生物安全 Level 1/2 的設施要求疊加到 GMP 廠房上，結果非疫苗廠也長得像疫苗廠（有大量負壓房間、圍堵設備）。
blocks.en: When the biotechnology industry was just starting, there was excessive concern about the environmental risk of GMOs, and many companies layered Biosafety Level 1/2 facility requirements on top of their GMP facilities. As a result, non-vaccine plants ended up looking like vaccine plants (with many negative-pressure rooms and containment equipment).

blocks.zh: 這是一個過度謹慎、缺乏科學依據的設計選擇，造成了不必要的建造成本和營運複雜度。ISPE Vol.6 本章的核心使命之一，就是澄清這個歷史誤解。
blocks.en: This was an overly cautious design choice with no scientific basis, and it caused unnecessary construction cost and operational complexity. One of the core missions of this chapter of ISPE Vol.6 is to clear up this historical misunderstanding.

blocks.zh: 2.3.1 Biosafety Containment — 生物安全等級（BSL）詳解
blocks.en: 2.3.1 Biosafety Containment: Biosafety Levels (BSL) in Detail

blocks.zh: BSL vs 潔淨室分級對照 Comparison Table
blocks.en: Comparison Table: BSL vs Cleanroom Classification

blocks.zh:
生物安全等級 (BSL)          潔淨室分級 (ISO/EU GMP)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
保護目標：工作人員/環境      保護目標：產品
衡量標準：微生物的危害性     衡量標準：產品暴露程度
設施特徵：負壓、HEPA排氣     設施特徵：正壓、HEPA送風
法規依據：CDC/NIH/IFBA      法規依據：FDA/EMA/PIC/S
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CHO 細胞工廠（單抗）：
  BSL = GLSP（最低）        分級 = 視開/閉而定
  → 不需 BSL 設施            → 若封閉：CNC 即可

BSL-3 疫苗廠（封閉製程）：
  BSL = BSL-3（高）         分級 = CNC（不分級）
  → 需負壓、HEPA排氣         → 不需潔淨室送風分級
  → 反直覺！高 BSL ≠ 高分級
blocks.en:
Biosafety level (BSL)            Cleanroom classification (ISO/EU GMP)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Protects: personnel/environment  Protects: product
Basis: hazard of the organism    Basis: degree of product exposure
Features: negative pressure,     Features: positive pressure,
  HEPA exhaust                     HEPA supply air
Regulatory basis: CDC/NIH/IFBA   Regulatory basis: FDA/EMA/PIC/S
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CHO cell facility (mAb):
  BSL = GLSP (lowest)            Classification = depends on open/closed
  → No BSL facility needed       → If closed: CNC is sufficient

BSL-3 vaccine facility (closed process):
  BSL = BSL-3 (high)             Classification = CNC (unclassified)
  → Needs negative pressure,     → No classified supply air needed
    HEPA exhaust
  → Counterintuitive! High BSL ≠ high classification

blocks.zh: 最反直覺的結論：BSL-3 工廠可以是 CNC（未分級）房間！
blocks.en: The most counterintuitive conclusion: a BSL-3 plant can be a CNC (controlled not classified) room!

blocks.zh: 如果 BSL-3 的疫苗製程是完全封閉的，那麼：
blocks.en: If the BSL-3 vaccine process is completely closed, then:

blocks.zh: 為了圍堵病毒，需要負壓和 HEPA 排氣
blocks.en: negative pressure and HEPA exhaust are needed to contain the virus

blocks.zh: 但因為產品沒有暴露在環境中，不需要潔淨室分級的送風
blocks.en: but because the product is not exposed to the environment, classified supply air for a cleanroom is not needed

blocks.zh: 這完全打破了「越危險就需要越多設施要求」的直覺。危險性高（BSL）≠ 環境分級高（GMP 潔淨室）。
blocks.en: This completely breaks the intuition that "the more dangerous it is, the more facility requirements are needed". High hazard (BSL) ≠ high environmental classification (GMP cleanroom).

blocks.zh: GLSP（Good Large Scale Practices）：這是大多數生物製藥廠商最熟悉的操作環境。生產單株抗體（mAb）、重組蛋白、基因工程藥物時使用的 CHO 細胞、大腸桿菌 K-12，都屬於 GLSP 等級。
blocks.en: GLSP (Good Large Scale Practices): this is the operating environment most familiar to biopharmaceutical companies. The CHO cells and E. coli K-12 used to make monoclonal antibodies (mAb), recombinant proteins and genetically engineered drugs all fall under GLSP.

blocks.zh: GLSP 意味著：不需要 BSL 設施要求，只需遵循 cGMP。這是為什麼典型的單抗工廠看起來像一般製藥廠，而不像傳染病實驗室。
blocks.en: GLSP means: no BSL facility requirements; only cGMP needs to be followed. This is why a typical mAb plant looks like an ordinary pharmaceutical plant rather than an infectious disease laboratory.

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 同時接受 CHO 細胞生產的重組蛋白藥物委託，以及活減毒病毒疫苗委託。這兩個產品的廠房設計要求有哪些根本差異？BSL 和 GMP 分級分別如何影響設計？
blocks.en: A CDMO accepts a project for a recombinant protein drug produced in CHO cells and another for a live attenuated virus vaccine. What are the fundamental differences in the facility design requirements for these two products? How do BSL and GMP classification each affect the design?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 ISPE 認為，過去許多非疫苗生物製藥廠「看起來像疫苗廠」是一個錯誤？這個錯誤的代價是什麼？
blocks.en: Why does ISPE consider it a mistake that many non-vaccine biopharmaceutical plants in the past "looked like vaccine plants"? What was the cost of this mistake?

blocks.zh: 2.4 Critical Quality Attributes and Critical Process Parameters — CQA 與 CPP
blocks.en: 2.4 Critical Quality Attributes and Critical Process Parameters: CQA and CPP

blocks.zh: CQA（Critical Quality Attribute，關鍵品質屬性）：直接影響產品安全性、有效性或純度的品質特性。對生物製劑而言，常見的 CQA 包括：
blocks.en: CQA (Critical Quality Attribute): a quality characteristic that directly affects product safety, efficacy or purity. For biologics, common CQAs include:

blocks.zh: 醣化模式 (Glycosylation pattern) — 影響半衰期和免疫原性
blocks.en: Glycosylation pattern: affects half-life and immunogenicity

blocks.zh: 聚集程度 (Aggregation) — 影響安全性
blocks.en: Aggregation: affects safety

blocks.zh: 宿主細胞蛋白 (Host Cell Protein, HCP) — 影響免疫反應
blocks.en: Host cell protein (HCP): affects the immune response

blocks.zh: 生物活性 (Biological activity)
blocks.en: Biological activity

blocks.zh: CPP（Critical Process Parameter，關鍵製程參數）：製程中若偏離可接受範圍，將對 CQA 產生重大影響的操作參數。
blocks.en: CPP (Critical Process Parameter): an operating parameter whose deviation from the acceptable range would significantly affect a CQA.

blocks.zh: 開放 vs 封閉製程的廠房需求對比
blocks.en: Facility Needs for Open vs Closed Processing

blocks.zh:
製程類型    環境是否為 CPP    廠房要求
──────────────────────────────────────────────
開放製程    是（環境是 CPP）  需要潔淨室分級
                             需要巢狀潔淨室架構
                             需要 PAL/MAL 氣鎖
                             需要壓差層疊（正壓）
                             需要人員換裝區
                             HVAC 需嚴格分區
──────────────────────────────────────────────
封閉製程    否（環境非 CPP）  以上均不強制要求
                             廠房設計大幅簡化
                             可採用 CNC 房間
                             仍需基本衛生管控
──────────────────────────────────────────────
設計決策邏輯：
  開放步驟 → 識別於 PFD → 設計 CPP 環境
  封閉步驟 → 廠房為非關鍵 → 設計可簡化
blocks.en:
Process type    Environment a CPP?   Facility requirements
──────────────────────────────────────────────
Open            Yes (environment     Classified cleanroom needed
                is a CPP)            Nested cleanroom structure needed
                                     PAL/MAL airlocks needed
                                     Cascading pressure differentials (positive) needed
                                     Personnel gowning area needed
                                     HVAC needs strict zoning
──────────────────────────────────────────────
Closed          No (environment      None of the above is mandatory
                is not a CPP)        Facility design is greatly simplified
                                     CNC rooms can be used
                                     Basic hygiene controls still needed
──────────────────────────────────────────────
Design decision logic:
  Open step → identify on the PFD → design the CPP environment
  Closed step → facility is non-critical → design can be simplified

blocks.zh: 想像你在戶外野餐（開放製程）vs. 在密封保溫盒裡存放食物（封閉製程）：
blocks.en: Compare an outdoor picnic (open processing) with storing food in a sealed insulated box (closed processing):

blocks.zh: 戶外野餐：需要選擇乾淨的環境、避開蒼蠅、注意天氣——周圍環境是「關鍵」因素（CPP）
blocks.en: Outdoor picnic: you need to choose a clean spot, avoid flies and watch the weather, so the surrounding environment is a "critical" factor (CPP)

blocks.zh: 密封保溫盒：食物完全不受外界影響，就算在骯髒的倉庫裡，食物也不會被汙染——環境是「非關鍵」因素
blocks.en: Sealed insulated box: the food is completely unaffected by the outside, and even in a dirty warehouse it will not be contaminated, so the environment is a "non-critical" factor

blocks.zh: 當你的製程步驟是「封閉」的，廠房環境就像保溫盒外面的倉庫——重要性大幅降低。
blocks.en: When your process step is "closed", the facility environment is like the warehouse outside the insulated box: its importance drops sharply.

blocks.zh: PFD（Process Flow Diagram，製程流程圖）的重要性：在設計廠房之前，工程師必須先識別哪些製程步驟是「開放」的（有產品暴露），哪些是「封閉」的。這些開放步驟在 PFD 上必須特別標記，因為它們決定了哪些房間需要潔淨室分級。
blocks.en: The importance of the PFD (Process Flow Diagram): before designing the facility, engineers must first identify which process steps are "open" (with product exposure) and which are "closed". These open steps must be specially marked on the PFD, because they determine which rooms need cleanroom classification.

blocks.zh: 這個邏輯是整個廠房設計的起點：先有製程分析，再有廠房設計。
blocks.en: This logic is the starting point of the whole facility design: process analysis comes first, then facility design.

blocks.zh: CDMO 的設計策略：最大化封閉製程步驟，最小化「CPP 環境」的比例。
blocks.en: CDMO design strategy: maximize closed process steps and minimize the proportion of "CPP environment".

blocks.zh: 若能將大部分製程步驟設計為封閉式，則潔淨室面積可大幅縮小，直接降低：
blocks.en: If most process steps can be designed as closed, the cleanroom area can be greatly reduced, which directly lowers:

blocks.zh: 建造成本（潔淨室建造費用是普通廠房的 3-10 倍）
blocks.en: Construction cost (building a cleanroom costs 3 to 10 times as much as an ordinary facility)

blocks.zh: HVAC 系統複雜度與能耗
blocks.en: HVAC system complexity and energy consumption

blocks.zh: 日常清潔驗證工作量
blocks.en: Routine cleaning validation workload

blocks.zh: 人員訓練與更衣時間
blocks.en: Personnel training and gowning time

blocks.zh: 這是現代生物製藥廠設計的核心效益驅動因素。
blocks.en: This is the core benefit driver in modern biopharmaceutical facility design.

blocks.zh: 一個單株抗體的上游製程（細胞培養）在封閉的一次性生物反應器中進行；下游純化的某一步驟需要開放式操作。請描述這兩個區域的廠房設計應有何不同？
blocks.en: The upstream process of a monoclonal antibody (cell culture) is run in a closed single-use bioreactor, while one downstream purification step requires open operation. Describe how the facility design of these two areas should differ.

blocks.zh: 如果「更衣」對封閉製程而言是「discretionary（非強制）」的，為什麼本節說它「有助於讓員工進入生產心態」？在 QMS 的角度，這個理由充分嗎？
blocks.en: If "gowning" is "discretionary" for closed processing, why does this section say it "helps put employees in a production mindset"? From a QMS perspective, is this reason sufficient?

blocks.zh: 2.5 Biopharmaceutical Production — 生物製藥生產優化現況
blocks.en: 2.5 Biopharmaceutical Production: The Current State of Production Optimization

blocks.zh: 生物製藥生產已進入「優化時代」。這個說法意義深遠：
blocks.en: Biopharmaceutical production has entered an "era of optimization". This statement has far-reaching implications:

blocks.zh: 1980-2000 年代：技術探索期，製程未必可重複，設施設計保守
blocks.en: 1980s-2000s: technology exploration period; processes were not necessarily reproducible and facility designs were conservative

blocks.zh: 2000-2010 年代：製程知識積累，開始規模化生產
blocks.en: 2000s-2010s: process knowledge accumulated and large-scale production began

blocks.zh: 2010 年代至今：製程預測性高，重心轉向成本優化、速度、彈性
blocks.en: 2010s to present: processes are highly predictable, and the focus has shifted to cost optimization, speed and flexibility

blocks.zh: 這個轉變直接影響了廠房設計哲學：從「確保安全」優先，到「安全 + 效率 + 彈性」並重。
blocks.en: This shift directly affects facility design philosophy: from putting "ensuring safety" first to balancing "safety + efficiency + flexibility".

blocks.zh: Ballroom 概念的比喻：
blocks.en: An analogy for the ballroom concept:

blocks.zh: 傳統開放製程的工廠就像一棟有許多小隔間辦公室的建築——每個製程步驟需要自己的房間，中間有走廊和門隔開。
blocks.en: A traditional open-processing plant is like a building with many small partitioned offices: each process step needs its own room, separated by corridors and doors.

blocks.zh: 封閉製程的 ballroom 工廠則像現代的開放式辦公室——所有人（製程步驟）在同一個大空間工作，但每個人有自己的「電腦桌面（封閉設備）」，不會互相干擾。
blocks.en: A closed-processing ballroom plant is like a modern open-plan office: everyone (every process step) works in the same large space, but each person has their own "computer desktop (closed equipment)" and does not interfere with others.

blocks.zh: 開放式辦公室的優點：節省空間、溝通方便、彈性高。缺點：需要更好的個人設備（封閉技術）來維持隱私（交叉汙染防護）。
blocks.en: Advantages of an open-plan office: saves space, easy communication, high flexibility. Disadvantage: it needs better personal equipment (closed technology) to maintain privacy (cross-contamination protection).

blocks.zh: 「封閉製程使製程與設施脫鉤（decouples）」是這一節最核心的設計原則。
blocks.en: "Closed processing decouples the process from the facility" is the core design principle of this section.

blocks.zh: 在開放製程時代，製程步驟與廠房環境緊密綁定——改變製程，往往需要改造廠房。封閉製程打破了這種綁定：
blocks.en: In the open-processing era, process steps were tightly bound to the facility environment, so changing the process often meant modifying the facility. Closed processing breaks this binding:

blocks.zh: 製程改變（新產品、新規模）→ 更換設備，不需改造廠房
blocks.en: Process change (new product, new scale) → change the equipment, with no facility modification needed

blocks.zh: 廠房可以多用途（multi-product）——不同產品在同一空間的不同封閉設備中生產
blocks.en: The facility can be multi-purpose (multi-product): different products are made in different closed equipment in the same space

blocks.zh: 廠房生命週期延長，投資回報率提高
blocks.en: The facility lifecycle is extended and the return on investment improves

blocks.zh: 「骯髒的裡面，乾淨的外面」（Dirty Inside, Clean Outside）原則：
blocks.en: The "Dirty Inside, Clean Outside" principle:

blocks.zh: 最後一個例子最能說明封閉製程的設計彈性——一個剛使用完的「骯髒」可移動容器（外部是乾淨的，但裡面有殘留物）可以和一個「乾淨」的容器共用同一部電梯。在開放製程時代，這絕對不被允許；但在封閉製程下，只要兩個容器的外表面都是乾淨的，內部的「骯髒」不會汙染對方。
blocks.en: The last example best illustrates the design flexibility of closed processing: a just-used "dirty" mobile vessel (clean on the outside, but with residue inside) can share the same elevator with a "clean" vessel. In the open-processing era this was absolutely not allowed; but with closed processing, as long as the outer surfaces of both vessels are clean, the "dirty" inside will not contaminate the other.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，這種設計彈性意味著更小的廠房佔地、更簡單的物流動線、更低的建造成本。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, this design flexibility means a smaller facility footprint, simpler material and personnel flows, and lower construction cost.

blocks.zh: 「封閉製程使製程與設施脫鉤」對 CDMO 的商業模式有什麼好處？若客戶未來引入一個新的生物藥，封閉設計的廠房如何降低廠房改造的成本？
blocks.en: What benefits does "closed processing decouples the process from the facility" bring to a CDMO's business model? If a customer later introduces a new biologic, how does a facility with a closed design reduce the cost of modification?

blocks.zh: 在 ballroom 概念中，多個不同產品的封閉製程步驟在同一房間同時進行——請問監管機構如何驗證這樣的設計符合交叉汙染防護要求（見 PIC/S Annex 2）？
blocks.en: In the ballroom concept, the closed process steps of several different products run at the same time in the same room. How do regulators verify that such a design meets cross-contamination prevention requirements (see PIC/S Annex 2)?

blocks.zh: 2.6 Facility Design Discussions — 法規機構對廠房設計的期望與討論
blocks.en: 2.6 Facility Design Discussions: Regulators' Expectations and Discussion of Facility Design

blocks.zh: 這一節代表了業界的「前沿思維」——這些概念在 2013 年出版時仍被認為是前瞻性的，部分至今仍在法規接受度上持續討論中。
blocks.en: This section represents the industry's "cutting-edge thinking". These concepts were still considered forward-looking when published in 2013, and some are still being debated in terms of regulatory acceptance today.

blocks.zh: ISPE 直接承認：反對這些概念的阻力主要是「情感因素」而非技術問題。這是一個非常誠實的陳述，說明產業界的設計保守性往往源自習慣，而非科學依據。
blocks.en: ISPE states directly: the resistance to these concepts is mainly "emotional" rather than technical. This is a very honest statement, showing that design conservatism in the industry often stems from habit rather than scientific evidence.

blocks.zh: 三種層次的多產品同室生產：
blocks.en: Three levels of multi-product operation in a shared room:

blocks.zh: 層次 1（較保守）：上游和下游在同一室，但一次只做一個產品，按活動批次（campaigned）生產。線路清潔以「房間」為基礎。
blocks.en: Level 1 (more conservative): upstream and downstream are in the same room, but only one product at a time, produced in campaigns. Line clearance is room-based.

blocks.zh: 層次 2（中等大膽）：多個產品同時進行上游，同時進行下游，在同一室。線路清潔以「設備」為基礎。
blocks.en: Level 2 (moderately bold): several products run upstream at the same time and downstream at the same time, in the same room. Line clearance is equipment-based.

blocks.zh: 層次 3（最前沿）：臨床二、三期與商業生產同室進行——因為它們都是 cGMP，不存在「臨床/商業分離」的法規問題，只是生產規模不同。
blocks.en: Level 3 (most advanced): Phase 2 and 3 clinical production and commercial production in the same room. Because they are all cGMP, there is no regulatory issue of "clinical/commercial segregation"; only the production scale differs.

blocks.zh: 線路清潔（Line Clearance）的粒度差異：
blocks.en: Differences in the granularity of line clearance:

blocks.zh: 想像一個咖啡廳同時提供拿鐵、卡布奇諾、美式咖啡：
blocks.en: Imagine a coffee shop that serves lattes, cappuccinos and Americanos at the same time:

blocks.zh: 「房間」清潔 = 做完所有訂單後才整體清潔咖啡機——效率最低，但最保守
blocks.en: "Room" cleaning = cleaning the whole coffee machine only after all orders are done: the least efficient, but the most conservative

blocks.zh: 「設備」清潔 = 每台咖啡機負責自己的品項，機器之間互相獨立，切換時只清潔各自的機器——效率高，需要完善的設備隔離設計
blocks.en: "Equipment" cleaning = each coffee machine handles its own drinks and the machines are independent of each other, so only the machine concerned is cleaned at changeover: efficient, but requires good equipment isolation design

blocks.zh: 生物製藥的 ballroom 設計就像後者：每套封閉設備自我清潔，房間本身不需要每次清潔。
blocks.en: A biopharmaceutical ballroom design is like the latter: each set of closed equipment cleans itself, and the room itself does not need to be cleaned each time.

blocks.zh: 臨床期 vs 商業生產同室的商業意義：
blocks.en: The commercial significance of clinical and commercial production in the same room:

blocks.zh: 許多 CDMO 擔心臨床期和商業生產混在一起會有監管問題。本節明確指出：只要都是 cGMP（Phase 2+），法規上沒有禁止同室生產——差異只在生產規模，不在法規層級。
blocks.en: Many CDMOs worry that mixing clinical and commercial production will cause regulatory problems. This section states clearly: as long as everything is cGMP (Phase 2+), there is no regulatory prohibition on sharing a room. The difference is only in production scale, not in regulatory level.

blocks.zh: 這對 CDMO 的商業模式影響巨大：一個設計良好的封閉 ballroom 可以同時服務多個處於不同臨床階段的客戶，大幅提高廠房的資產利用率（Asset Utilization Rate）。
blocks.en: This has a huge impact on a CDMO's business model: a well-designed closed ballroom can serve several customers at different clinical stages at the same time, greatly raising the asset utilization rate of the facility.

blocks.zh: ISPE 說反對封閉 ballroom 概念的阻力是「emotional（情感性的）」而非技術性的。你認為在實際廠房審查中，監管機構（如 FDA 查廠官員）對這些概念的態度是什麼？廠商如何準備說服監管機構接受這樣的設計？
blocks.en: ISPE says the resistance to the closed ballroom concept is "emotional" rather than technical. In real facility inspections, what do you think is the attitude of regulators (such as FDA investigators) toward these concepts? How can a company prepare to persuade regulators to accept such a design?

blocks.zh: 「線路清潔以設備為基礎（equipment basis）」需要哪些文件和驗證工作，來向監管機構證明設備間不會發生交叉汙染？
blocks.en: What documentation and validation work is needed for "line clearance on an equipment basis" to demonstrate to regulators that cross-contamination between equipment cannot occur?

blocks.zh: 2.7 Sources of Information — 資訊來源
blocks.en: 2.7 Sources of Information

blocks.zh: 業界標準來源的四個層次：
blocks.en: Four tiers of industry standard sources:

blocks.zh: 法規層（FDA、EMA、PIC/S）：具法律約束力，必須遵守
blocks.en: Regulatory tier (FDA, EMA, PIC/S): legally binding and must be followed

blocks.zh: 技術標準層（ASME BPE、ISO）：產業公認的工程標準，不具法律效力但廣泛採用
blocks.en: Technical standards tier (ASME BPE, ISO): engineering standards recognized by the industry; not legally binding but widely adopted

blocks.zh: 行業組織層（ISPE、PDA）：最佳實踐指引，如本書 Vol.6
blocks.en: Industry organization tier (ISPE, PDA): best-practice guidance, such as this Vol.6

blocks.zh: 產業聯盟層（BPOG、BPSA）：業者自組聯盟，解決共同問題，發布白皮書
blocks.en: Industry consortium tier (BPOG, BPSA): consortia formed by companies themselves to solve common problems and publish white papers

blocks.zh: BPOG（BioPhorum Operations Group） 是近年來越來越有影響力的產業聯盟，成員包括全球主要的生物製藥廠商（輝瑞、羅氏、安進等）。BPOG 發布的最佳實踐文件在 FDA 查廠中越來越被引用，了解 BPOG 的立場對設計合規廠房十分重要。
blocks.en: BPOG (BioPhorum Operations Group) is an industry consortium that has become increasingly influential in recent years; its members include the world's major biopharmaceutical companies (Pfizer, Roche, Amgen and others). BPOG best-practice documents are cited more and more often in FDA inspections, so understanding BPOG's positions is important when designing a compliant facility.

blocks.zh: ASME BPE（Bioprocessing Equipment） 是生物製藥設備設計的黃金標準，涵蓋管路、閥門、容器的設計規範，確保可清潔性（cleanability）和可滅菌性（sterilizability）。
blocks.en: ASME BPE (Bioprocessing Equipment) is the gold standard for biopharmaceutical equipment design. It covers design requirements for piping, valves and vessels to ensure cleanability and sterilizability.

blocks.zh: 在廠房設計文件中引用 ASME BPE 標準和 ISPE Baseline Guide 時，這些文件的法律地位是什麼？FDA 查廠時若發現廠商未遵守這些標準，會有什麼後果？
blocks.en: When facility design documents cite ASME BPE standards and ISPE Baseline Guides, what is the legal status of these documents? What consequences would there be if FDA found during an inspection that a company had not followed these standards?

blocks.zh: 作為 CDMO，加入或追蹤 BPOG 的活動有什麼商業價值？
blocks.en: What is the commercial value for a CDMO of joining or following BPOG activities?

blocks.zh: 本章重點回顧 Chapter Summary
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: 法規趨向一致（Harmonized cGMP）：FDA、EMA、PIC/S、CFDA、日本 GMP 均支持封閉製程可放寬環境分級要求——這是廠房設計最重要的法規趨勢。
blocks.en: Harmonized cGMP: FDA, EMA, PIC/S, CFDA and Japanese GMP all support relaxing environmental classification requirements for closed processing. This is the most important regulatory trend for facility design.

blocks.zh: 生物安全圍堵（Containment）≠ 環境分級（Classification）：圍堵是防止生物體「逃出」（保護人員/環境）；分級是防止汙染物「進入」（保護產品）——兩者方向相反，不能混用。
blocks.en: Biosafety containment ≠ environmental classification: containment prevents organisms from "getting out" (protecting personnel/environment); classification prevents contaminants from "getting in" (protecting the product). The two run in opposite directions and must not be mixed up.

blocks.zh: 大多數生物藥（非疫苗）屬於 GLSP：使用 CHO 細胞、大腸桿菌等非致病性細胞株，不需 BSL 設施要求，只需遵循 cGMP。
blocks.en: Most biologics (non-vaccine) fall under GLSP: they use non-pathogenic cell lines such as CHO cells and E. coli, need no BSL facility requirements, and only need to follow cGMP.

blocks.zh: CPP 是廠房設計的起點：識別哪些製程步驟是開放的（環境是 CPP），哪些是封閉的（環境非 CPP），決定廠房的分級要求。
blocks.en: The CPP is the starting point of facility design: identifying which process steps are open (environment is a CPP) and which are closed (environment is not a CPP) determines the classification requirements of the facility.

blocks.zh: 封閉製程使製程與設施脫鉤：封閉設計的廠房可實現 ballroom 概念、多產品同室生產、同室多步驟操作，大幅降低廠房面積與成本。
blocks.en: Closed processing decouples the process from the facility: a facility with a closed design can realize the ballroom concept, multi-product operation in a shared room and multi-step operation in a shared room, greatly reducing facility area and cost.

blocks.zh: 法規文字 ≠ 監管期望：21 CFR Part 211 自 1976 年未改，但 FDA 的詮釋已大幅演進——必須了解「當下的」監管期望，而非僅閱讀舊法規文字。
blocks.en: Regulatory text ≠ regulatory expectation: 21 CFR Part 211 has not changed since 1976, but FDA's interpretation has evolved considerably. You must understand current regulatory expectations, not just read the old regulatory text.

blocks.zh: 阻力往往是情感性的：業界對 ballroom 設計的抵制主要來自習慣，而非技術或法規障礙——了解這一點，有助於在客戶溝通中做出更有說服力的設計提案。
blocks.en: Resistance is often emotional: industry resistance to the ballroom design comes mainly from habit, not from technical or regulatory obstacles. Understanding this helps you make more persuasive design proposals in customer discussions.

blocks.zh: 本章最核心洞察 — 雙向防護的設計哲學
blocks.en: The Chapter's Core Insight: A Design Philosophy of Two-Way Protection

blocks.zh: 生物製藥廠房設計最獨特的挑戰，在於它必須同時滿足兩個「方向相反」的防護要求：
blocks.en: The most distinctive challenge of biopharmaceutical facility design is that it must meet two protection requirements that run in opposite directions at the same time:

blocks.zh: 生物安全圍堵 (Biosafety Containment)
blocks.en: Biosafety Containment

blocks.zh:
方向：由內向外（防止生物體逃出）
目的：保護工作人員與環境
技術手段：負壓、HEPA 排氣、個人防護
監管依據：CDC/NIH/IFBA
適用：BSL-1/2/3 設施（主要是疫苗廠）
blocks.en:
Direction: inside to outside (prevent organisms from escaping)
Purpose: protect personnel and the environment
Technical means: negative pressure, HEPA exhaust, personal protection
Regulatory basis: CDC/NIH/IFBA
Applies to: BSL-1/2/3 facilities (mainly vaccine plants)

blocks.zh: 環境分級 (GMP Classification)
blocks.en: GMP Classification

blocks.zh:
方向：由外向內（防止汙染進入產品）
目的：保護產品品質
技術手段：正壓、HEPA 送風、潔淨服
監管依據：FDA/EMA/PIC/S/cGMP
適用：所有生物製藥廠（視開放程度）
blocks.en:
Direction: outside to inside (prevent contamination from entering the product)
Purpose: protect product quality
Technical means: positive pressure, HEPA supply air, cleanroom garments
Regulatory basis: FDA/EMA/PIC/S/cGMP
Applies to: all biopharmaceutical plants (depending on the degree of openness)

blocks.zh:
對大多數生物藥廠（使用 GLSP 細胞株，非疫苗）：只需考慮 GMP Classification，不需要 BSL 設施。
對疫苗廠：必須同時滿足 BSL 圍堵要求（負壓）和 GMP 分級要求——廠房工程師必須設計出能化解這個矛盾的方案。
blocks.en:
For most biopharmaceutical plants (using GLSP cell lines, non-vaccine): only GMP classification needs to be considered; no BSL facility is needed.
For vaccine plants: both BSL containment requirements (negative pressure) and GMP classification requirements must be met, and facility engineers must design a solution that resolves this conflict.
